name: Complex Hallucination
body:
Complex Hallucination
Source Ultimate Intrigue pg. 206
School illusion (phantasm) [mind-affecting]; Level arcanist 4, bard 4, magus 4, medium 3, mesmerist 4, occultist 4, psychic 4, skald 4, sorcerer 4, witch 4, wizard 4
Casting
Casting Time 1 standard action
Components S
Effect
Range long (400 ft. + 40 ft./level)
Target one creature/level, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart
Duration concentration + 3 rounds
Saving Throw Will disbelief; Spell Resistance yes
Description
This spell functions as audiovisual hallucination, except that the phantasm you create can also include olfactory, tactile, and thermal effects.
